title: Treachery
note: Blizzard's order from conversation.json (trigger groups as listed, lines by conversationOrder).

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Damn it! How could this have happened? The city lies in ashes...

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We have to stay focused. These people are counting on us to lead them to safety.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They were counting on us to keep them safe. And we failed.

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Look, survivors!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Sir, we were separated from our unit and got lost down here.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We’re headed for the exit tunnel. Help us protect the civilians and we can all get out of here alive.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Look at all of this! How long have these cultist rats been skulking in the sewers?

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: They must have been planning this coup for years. Our friends and neighbors...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To know this rot has been festering beneath our feet all this time...

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We’ll leave the civilians here while we secure the path ahead.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Lock the gates until we return. And if we don’t...

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: ...then Light be with you.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: The city guard! I knew there had to be more survivors!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: We have a group of civilians with us. Can you open the gate?

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: No, sir. Those damn cultists took apart the winch. You’ll need to get the cogwheels back from them.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then it looks like it’s time to hunt some cultists.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That's Baron Rivendare, Master of Stratholme!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: My lord! We have a group of civilians-

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: How fortunate. Your survivors will make fine additions to the Scourge.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You're a filthy traitor, just like Arthas!

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Our dear prince is merely an instrument of a far greater plan. One which I helped to devise.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Now this weak and pathetic kingdom will die, and from its corpse will rise an army of the damned.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: These vermin are beneath me. Slaughter them and hunt down the rest of the survivors.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Everyone head to the surface!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: No, Captain. You can get the survivors to Andorhal without me.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I’m not leaving here while Rivendare draws breath.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek, this is madness. You can't possibly-

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Justice won't find him unless someone brings it to him. If not now, then when?

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Soldier, I leave these civilians in your charge.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Let’s make this quick, Lieutenant.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: How eagerly you sought your own death. So quick to play the hero.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: But you are no one! Merely another corpse to serve--

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The barrier is down! Run!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What?! No! I’m not abandoning you!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Forget about me! You need to get the civilians to Andorhal!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain, I--

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: That’s an order, damn it!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Light be with you, sir.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Go, Garek. Be who you were meant to be.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You think you can escape?! These sewers will be your tomb!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: For Lordaeron!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Lieutenant Bandarion, you’re alive! But... where’s Captain Landen?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: He... he didn't make it.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: We need to regroup with Uther at Andorhal. Let's get moving.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Civilians in the back. The rest of us will take point.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Arthas is still laying waste to the city...

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: If we secure a way out, perhaps more survivors can be saved.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Wait... Why are there so many supplies down here?

lines.speaker: Master Blightweaver
lines.text: Intruders! Slay them all!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: What is this place?!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Too much rubble. We'll have to find another route.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Looks like there's only one path forward.

lines.speaker: Blightweaver
lines.text: There will be no “path forward” for you!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Everyone, to arms!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The cult must have followed us into the sewers. We need to keep moving!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Thank the Light! Stay here, I'll go back to gather the survivors.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain! I hear voices up ahead!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: There's the exit!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Look out!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: That should do it. Let's move.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The exit tunnel should be nearby. Stay Sharp.

lines.speaker: Apothecary Venomspite
lines.text: You dare interrupt my work?!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Those fumes must be the "work" we interrupted. We need a way to clear them out.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Hmm. This should protect us from the fumes.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Ugh! What are these things?!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's an ambush!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: What vile sorcery is this?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Whatever it is, it ends now!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Rivendare! You will pay for your crimes!

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: More lambs to the slaughter!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Thank the Light! Stay here, I'll go back to gather the survivors.

lines.speaker: Mordo
lines.text: Rivendare will reward me for this!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Die, cultist scum!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: I'll see Rivendare's head on a pike!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Justice will find him, Garek. We need to focus on bringing the survivors to Andorhal.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You don't have to do this, sir.

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Yes I do. I'm not letting you face Rivendare alone.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain... I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: Run all you like, little rat! I'll catch you yet!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Need to put some debris in his way. Breaking these support pillars should do it.

lines.speaker: Baron Rivendare
lines.text: You cannot escape your fate. All of Lordaeron will fall to the Scourge!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Something cold and menacing lurks in this darkness.

lines.speaker: Araj the Summoner
lines.text: Foolish mortals. You have sealed your fate!

lines.speaker: Araj the Summoner
lines.text: I will return...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Foul lich...

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: These spiders are huge...

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: There must be a broodmother nearby.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Wretched beast!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: With the broodmother dead, the swarm should scatter.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Captain! Get me out of these webs!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: She's webbed me up! I can't move!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: Garek! Cut these webs and free me!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: I'm ensnared! Free me, quickly!

lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: Over here! Let me out!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: The city guard! Please, help me!

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Help! Break open the cage!

lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I'm in your debt. I'll fight by your side!

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: You have my thanks! Let's get out of here!

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: I thought I would die in there! These cultists will pay!

lines.speaker: Landen
lines.text: The city's central furnace. It's still pumping heat.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: To homes that Arthas turned into charnel houses. We need to shut off the flames.
